user_query: Analyze this protein sequence and report sequence properties, closest curated Swiss-Prot homologs and their functional annotations, potential cellular process/pathway roles, and subcellular localization. Clearly distinguish direct annotations from homology-based inference; avoid overclaiming exact function.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.

function: Promotes RNA polymerase assembly. Latches the N- and C-terminal regions of the beta' subunit thereby facilitating its interaction with the beta and alpha subunits.
